source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.1, ultrasound and the piezoelectric effect (PDF 157-158).

blocks.text: Ultrasound bohat istemal hone wala, non-invasive (jism ko kaate ya andar kuch daale baghair) medical imaging ka tareeqa hai jis se jism ke andar ke hisse, jaise tissues, aza aur hamal (pregnancy) mein bachcha, dekhe ja sakte hain. Yeh piezoelectric effect naam ke physics ke usool par chalta hai, jo ultrasound transducer (probe) ke kaam ki bunyad hai. Transducer do kaam karta hai: ultrasound waves banata bhi hai aur jism ke andar se wapas aane wale (reflected) signals pakarta bhi hai.
Lafz "piezoelectric" Greek lafz "piezein" se bana hai jis ka matlab hai "dabana", aur "electric" ka matlab bijli paida hona.

Yeh effect 1880 mein do French scientists, Pierre Curie aur Jacques Curie, ne daryaft kiya. Woh quartz, tourmaline aur Rochelle salt (sodium potassium tartrate) jaise crystals par tajurbe kar rahe the. Unhon ne dekha ke in crystals ko mechanical pressure se dabane par electric charge paida hota hai, yani kuch crystals mein mechanical force aur bijli ka gehra talluq hai. Yeh effect kuch crystals ki khaas andaruni banawat ki wajah se hota hai. Piezoelectric effect ki do qismein hain: direct aur converse. In crystals ka koi centre of symmetry (aisa markazi nuqta jis ke dono taraf banawat bilkul ek jaisi ho) nahi hota, aur in ke andar positive aur negative charge ke chhote hisse hote hain. Aam halat mein yeh charges barabar (balanced) rehte hain; dabane par yeh tawazun bigarta hai, charges thora khisakte hain aur surface par electric field ban jata hai. Ise direct piezoelectric effect kehte hain. Ulta, agar crystal par electric field lagayein to us ki shakal thori badal jati hai; ise converse piezoelectric effect kehte hain. Is ka kaam Fig. 20.1 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit!
blocks.text: Piezoelectric effect se pressure ko voltage mein aur voltage ko pressure mein badla ja sakta hai. Isi tarah ultrasound jism se "baat" karta hai: probe voltage se awaz ki waves bhejta hai aur wapas aane wali waves ko voltage mein badal kar pakarta hai.

blocks.alt: Do metal plates ke darmiyan PZT (lead zirconate titanate) ki takhti ko oopar aur neeche se teer dabate hain. Takhti ke oopar musbat aur neeche manfi charge zahir hote hain. Taar dono plates ko jorta hai, jis par bijli ka nishan 'Voltage' hai. Label: Compressing produces electricity.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.1: piezoelectric effect ka khaaka (kitab ki Figure 20.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Crystal (PZT) ko dabane se oopar musbat aur neeche manfi charge jama hote hain aur dono metal plates ke darmiyan voltage paida hota hai: yeh direct piezoelectric effect hai. Ulta, voltage lagane se crystal ki shakal thori badalti hai (converse effect); ultrasound probe isi se lehrein banata hai. Kitab ne 'Led Zircoante Tianate' chhapa hai; sahi naam Lead Zirconate Titanate hai.

blocks.prompt: Direct aur converse piezoelectric effect mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Direct: crystal par mechanical dabao voltage paida karta hai. Converse: lagaya gaya voltage crystal ki shakal badalta hai (is liye alternating voltage use thartharata hai).

items: Ultrasound transducer piezoelectric effect par chalta hai: waves banata bhi hai aur pakarta bhi.
Piezoelectric effect (Pierre aur Jacques Curie, 1880): centre of symmetry ke baghair crystals (quartz, tourmaline, Rochelle salt).
Direct: dabao se surface par electric field (voltage); converse: electric field se crystal ki shakal badalti hai.
